newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CVNE to sell 21.72 pct of capital - CNMV.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CVNE to sell 21.72 pct of capital - CNMV.

text.p: Spanish wine producer Compania Vinicola del Norte de Espana (CVNE) will sell 21.72 percent of its capital in an initial public offering, Stock Market Commission CNMV said on Tuesday.

"The percentage of its capital for the offer is 21.72 percent which could be raised by 2.975 percent based on a buy option which Chase Manhattan bank is offering," the company said in a mandatory disclosure to the CNMV.

The 21.72 percent initial offer is divided into a subscription and sale offer, composed of 6.81 percent and 14.91 percent respectively. Both offers have the same rights, without any distinctions, the mandatory disclosure said.

The offers will have an initial nominal value of 123.8 million pesetas and will be conducted domestically. Both have 75 percent destined initially for the retail market with 25 percent directed at the institutional market.
The sale is being directed by Chase Manhattan Bank CMB S.A., which also acts as global coordinator and underwriter.
